body:
River Fog
CR 4

XP 1,200
NE haunt (5 ft. by 20 ft. section of a river)
Caster Level 4th
Notice Perception DC 14 (the water begins to produce fog)
hp 8; Weakness susceptible to fire; Trigger proximity;
Reset 1 minute

EFFECT

When this haunt is triggered, the area over the water begins to form a fog as per the spell stinking cloud but only a 5 ft by 20 ft area. Those inside the cloud must succeed a DC 14 save or succumb to the cloud’s nauseating effects.

DESTRUCTION

The body of the witch trapped at the bottom of the river must be removed and burned.
